Third-party libraries included in this folder
=============================================

pdfmake 0.3.11 (pdfmake.min.js, pdfmake-times.js)
  https://github.com/bpampuch/pdfmake
  The MIT License (MIT). Copyright (c) 2014-2015 bpampuch, 2016-2025 Libor M.
  pdfmake-times.js contains Adobe font metrics (AFM) for the standard
  PDF "Times" fonts, distributed with pdfkit/pdfmake.
